# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 12 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 12:3 — I have gotten a man vs. I have acquired a man

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I have gotten a man child" | Literal acquisivi hominem — echoes Gen 4:1 |
| LOGOS | "I have acquired a man" | More precise rendering of acquisivi |
| PNEUMA | "I have had a son" | Paraphrase; loses the 'acquisition' motif |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS 'acquired' captures the Latin acquisivi precisely. EMET's 'gotten' is acceptable but slightly informal. PNEUMA loses the deliberate echo of Eve's words at Cain's birth. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
